title: To Measure the World!
description: A researcher who wants to measure the world seems to have run into a bottleneck...

mainQuestExcel.title: To Measure the World!
mainQuestExcel.description: A researcher who wants to measure the world seems to have run into a bottleneck...

dialogs.text: Hey, friend, can I have a moment of your time?
What is it?
Now, have you ever thought about this: what will happen if the sky falls?
You are worrying too much...
That may be so. But why doesn't the sky fall? Why won't the earth collapse? Without accurate measurements, we'll never have answers to these questions.
In fact, I've come up with a model that explains these questions perfectly. I just need more observational data to support it...
So, do you need my help?
So you are willing to help, then? Many thanks to you!
I've chosen a perfect spot for my observations, but some monsters are active there.
Please, drive them away so I can conduct my observations safely.
Sure.
Thanks a lot. Let's be on our way, then.
Do you need to be at the scene yourself?
I need to get some data on-site to find the cause of any discrepancies in my calculations.
Fixating on a pile of papers will only lead you further away from the correct answer, so let's hit the road.
Good luck. See you.
Wait, wait! Please reconsider. If my work is published, it could be earthshaking!
You will then be a collaborator in this great theoretical undertaking. I can also put your name in the acknowledgments...
Or... Or you could even be my co-author...
Are things really this urgent?
If I can't get results, I'm afraid that I'll have a problem getting research funding... And that would be far more devastating than the sky falling.
I wouldn't demand co-authorship.
I prefer to be paid fairly.
Technically, it can't.
I'm really busy right now.
Oh, please don't say that. What could be more serious than the incoming collapse of one's own house?
Your house is... collapsing?
Ahem... Of course not. But say you live in a house, and you've never seen it in its entirety, and no one has ever guaranteed its structural strength...
Wouldn't living in this house every day worry you somehow? Such is also the case with living in this world.

flow.stepDescription: Defeat the enemies near the destination

dialogs.text: Hmm... So that's it. Introduce this variable, and the discrepancies can be explained.
But does that change my other deductions?
Any progress?
Sorry, I forgot that you were still here... Here's your payment.
As for my progress... I've fixed some issues, but new ones have emerged. That's research, I guess.
I might have to keep troubling you, Traveler, until I reach a final conclusion.
Hey friend, can I have a moment of your time?
What is it?
Now, have you ever thought about this: what will happen if the sky falls?
You are worrying too much...
That may be so. But why doesn't the sky fall? Why won't the earth collapse? Without accurate measurements, we'll never have answers to these questions.
In fact, I've come up with a model that explains these questions perfectly. I just need more observational data to support it...
So, do you need my help?
So you are willing to help, then? Many thanks to you!
Actually, I have ordered a customized set of beacons that will automatically collect the raw data necessary to support my deductions.
They need to be set up on high places such as cliffs and mountaintops for the raw data to stay free of the possible effects of terrains.
But as you can see, I'm not much of a climber...
Leave it to me.
Thank you! The sampling sites are nearby. Just let me know when you're done.
You didn't take terrain into account when placing your order?
Ahem... The sensitivity of the instrument was a priority, so the range of applications was naturally sacrificed...
After all, the calculations could veer far off the mark even if we make only a small mistake. Anyways, I'm counting on you.
Good luck. See you.

Or... Or you could even be my co-author...

I wouldn't demand co-authorship.
I prefer to be paid fairly.
Technically, it can't.
I'm really busy right now.
Oh, please don't say that. What could be more serious than the incoming collapse of one's own house?
Your house is... collapsing?
Ahem... Of course not. But say you live in a house, and you've never seen it in its entirety, and no one has ever guaranteed its structural strength...
Wouldn't living in this house every day worry you somehow? Such is also the case with living in this world.
Hopefully there won't be any more data errors this time...
Huh? Have you finished setting up all the beacons?
We're all set.
Thank you so much. Please take this as your payment.
Now all I have to do is wait for them to collect the data, and then I'll be able to confirm my deduction!
Still, how am I supposed to go up and retrieve the beacons...?
Ah, Traveler, you've finally come!
How's your research going?
Thanks to you, I've made huge progress in the past few days. The beacons should be collecting data as we speak.
Now I only have to retrieve the data and verify my new conjectures!
All you have done these days is make conjectures!?
Well, I've optimized some equations and calibrated my instruments. After all...
I won't be able to climb up to the locations where you set those beacons.
I'm afraid I'll have to trouble you to retrieve those beacons.
Well, alright then...
Please, Traveler! I will take care of the payment, do not fret.
Why don't you take retrieval into account next time...
I have weighed some options, you know. Adding a retrieval device, expanding our range of applications... things like that.
But they require a higher budget, and I'm not sure how this might affect the data precision.
Anyways, I'll be counting on you this time as well!
You haven't made any progress at all...

flow.stepDescription: Go to where the beacons were set up

dialogs.text: Hopefully there won't be any more data errors this time...
Hopefully there won't be any more data errors this time...
What? Monsters, out there? This doesn't make sense. The environmental parameters showed that...
Could the beacons have become variables themselves? Perhaps their vibrations and sounds attracted the monsters...
Oh no, will these things affect the data? Ah, sorry. I've been talking to myself again.
I didn't expect to cause you extra trouble. My apologies, and please, take this as your payment.
I should be more conscientious with my measurements next time.
